description: This file serves as the entry point for the Calendar module in SuiteCRM, handling access control, initializing calendar views, managing shared and personal calendar data, and rendering the calendar display.

classes.name: Calendar
classes.description: Represents the calendar view, managing activities, sharing, and view-specific logic.

classes.name: CalendarDisplay
classes.description: Responsible for rendering the calendar's HTML output including header, footer, and activities display.

methods.name: display_title
methods.description: Outputs the title of the calendar view.

methods.name: display_shared_html
methods.description: Displays shared calendar specific HTML components.

methods.name: display_calendar_header
methods.description: Renders the header section of the calendar.

methods.name: display_calendar_footer
methods.description: Renders the footer section of the calendar.
